steps.title: How it works
steps.subtitle: Three steps, in this order. The middle one is the only real work — and it is done in one sitting.

open.title: Open your partner account
open.body: Tell us about your shop. Once you are approved, your first two events are free. After that, pay for each event or buy a pack.

build.title: Build the invitation
build.body: You build it on our platform — the event details, the photos, the schedule, the guest list. It all goes in one place.

sell.title: Send it out
sell.body: Pick a design and use one credit — the invitation is live the same minute. Send your customer the link for their guests list, and they can start inviting immediately.

pricing.title: Buy more, keep more
pricing.subtitle: Shops sell a Basic invitation for $60–85. Your first two events cost you nothing. After that, pay for each event with nothing up front, or buy a pack and pay less for every one.

trial.name: Free trial
trial.note: Make two real invitations for two real customers before you pay us anything. Whatever you charge for them, you keep.

payg.name: Pay as you go
payg.note: You pay half the package price, every time. A good way to start while you are still not sure how many events you will get.

pricing.footnote: These are Basic package prices. The Standard package sells for $120–150 per event and has its own partner prices — ask us when we open your account. The profit shown assumes you sell every invitation in the pack. What you charge your own customer is up to you. Prices in US dollars.

freeStart.title: It costs nothing to start
freeStart.body: Your first two invitations are free. Buy a pack only once the work is steady.

unsold.q: What happens if I do not sell them all?
unsold.a: Your credits stay in your account until you use them. Each pack has its own expiry date, shown on your credits page. If you are not sure how many events you will get, use your two free events, pay per event for a while, and buy a pack once the work is steady.

price.q: Can I set my own price?
price.a: Yes. The prices on this page are what you pay us. What you charge your customer is completely up to you, and we take none of it.

domain.q: Is the invitation under my own brand?
domain.a: Your shop's logo appears next to ours at the bottom of every invitation. The invitation itself lives on goevent.online, which is what keeps it fast and leaves you nothing to look after. You cannot put it on your own web address.

plans.q: Do credits work on any design?
plans.a: Credits only work on the package you bought them for. A Basic credit opens any Basic design, for any kind of event — but not a Standard one. This page shows Basic prices.

payment.q: How do I pay for a pack?
payment.a: Bank transfer or QR. Order the pack, upload your payment slip, and we add the credits once we have checked it — usually the same working day.

customer.q: Does my customer need an account?
customer.a: No. You create and own the event; their names appear on it as the hosts. Their guests only ever open a link — no app, no sign-up, nothing to install.

names.q: Do I have to type in all my customer's guests?
names.a: No. Send your customer a link to the guest list and they fill it in themselves — no account, no app, nothing to install. You decide whether the link only lets them read the list and copy each guest's invitation, or add and correct names too, and you can switch it off once the event is over.

apply.q: How do I become a partner?
apply.a: Send us a request with your shop's name, a number we can call you on, and roughly how many events you take on each month. We read every request ourselves and normally reply within two working days.

closing.title: Your first two invitations are on us
closing.subtitle: Tell us about your shop. If it is a good fit we will open your account, and you can make two real invitations before you pay us anything.
